english.note: Central alternatives PTE59 / Michigan English53 (B2). TOEFL/IELTS valid two years, single sitting, no superscoring. Exemptions require qualifying US degree, listed primary-English-country degree, or qualifying country of origin and official documentation; program may set higher requirements.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic fee $50. Central waivers exclude international applicants. Some departments offer selective discount codes; availability here is not confirmed.

requirements.note: Central bachelor's-equivalent and GPA3.0 standards apply; program-specific GRE and recommendation requirements not established on checked pages. Unless self-funded, department recommends not submitting until faculty financial commitment secured. Self-funded applicants may apply meeting Graduate School requirements and should note self-funding.

funding.note: Some students receive competitive faculty-awarded research/teaching assistantships, with full tuition and fee waiver. Contact individual faculty; funding is a limiting admissions factor.
